title: TickWatch
description: The project is a Minecraft server monitoring plugin called TickWatch that integrates with Discord webhooks to provide real-time performance reports, including TPS, memory, and CPU usage, along with configurable warning thresholds.
body:
## **TickWatch** - Advanced Server Monitoring Plugin

A comprehensive real-time server performance monitoring solution for Minecraft servers with Discord webhook integration.

## > 🚀 Features
- TPS (Ticks Per Second) tracking with 1-minute, 5-minute, and 15-minute averages
- Memory Usage monitoring with detailed heap statistics
- CPU Load tracking with process and system-level metrics
- Live GUI Updates with automatic refresh every 2 seconds


## > Interactive Dashboard
- Complete Dashboard - All-in-one monitoring interface with live performance graphs
- Performance Overview - Quick summary of server health status
- Detailed Analytics - In-depth system information and metrics
- Visual Indicators - Color-coded status bars and trend graphs

## > Discord Webhook Alerts
- Automated Notifications for performance issues
- Configurable Thresholds for TPS, Memory, and CPU alerts
- Smart Cooldown System to prevent alert spam
- Custom Alert Types - Warning and Critical levels
- Rich Embeds with server statistics and uptime information

## > 🔧 Commands
- /tw or /tickwatch - Open main monitoring interface
- /tw dashboard - Open complete performance dashboard
- /tw performance - View performance overview
- /tw help - Display command help
- /tw reload - Reload configuration (Admin)
- /tw debug - Toggle debug mode (Admin)
- /tw testwebhook - Send test Discord notification (Admin)
